title: The Channel of Freedom
subtitle: That impulse, like radio wave, is untouchable yet real.

trails.title: A Blank Space
trails.description: An ad which doesn't appear in the ad section. It's written passionately, like telling a soft, smooth, cloud-like dream.

content.text:
"FLURRY PUPPY GAMES"
SPONSORSHIP RIGHTS INVITATION NOTICE

{p}The Funniest Game is in town! Thousands of fluffy athletes from hundreds of streets in dozens of blocks will gather here for the most exciting pet contest!
{p}The Flurry Puppy Games has
been held 4 times since 1961.
From only hundreds of
athletes of 3 suburbs taking
part in the first Game to
today's thousands of athletes
from more than 28 suburbs showing up, great change has taken place. The Flurry Puppy Games has become an important event to promote pet sports and friendship.

If you wish to donate or sponsor the game, please contact 01-723 6691.{img}

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Brilliant. Although there were some unexpected hiccups ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Our plan went well. The fuse has been changed, bullets replaced, magnet installed ... Most robots have been paralysed.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Even Mr. Iverson seems to be at a loss.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: It's not over yet.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Yes. Heh heh, it's better to say that the show hasn't yet begun.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Let's turn up the light, turn down the air conditioning, and crank up the usage of the radio.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Let's see. When will the replaced fuse blow?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ms. Acey, we don't have much time left.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Come on. Let me bring you to a hidden place. Hopefully, you don't mind swallowing a slightly bulky "thing."

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: What tricks did you come up with?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: This is going to be the most crucial part. Hee hee.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Please help me, Ms. Acey.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Actually, according to Item 18 in the Safety Commitment Statement, we need to arrest the violators who interrupt others' visit.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Tie him up and inject Miu Miu Mute You Potion. I don't want to hear his stupid ideas anymore.

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Command received.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Umm ... umm umm ...

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Activate the spraying system. Clean all those damn bubbles.
The crowd seems to calm down under the fire of the water gun and sedative spraying.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: The farce is over.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: All our guests, please enjoy your visit.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Unfortunately, those who were bewitched and violated the Safety Commitment Statement, you will be further investigated after the exhibition.
Iverson is concentrated on the crowd that's cooling down, but he doesn't realize the bulb above is getting brighter.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof …
Pickles rubs against Charlton, like a farewell before departure.
Woof woof ...
Pickles hears the barking of dogs in the distance. The sound is so familiar and friendly.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof?
Footsteps are getting closer and clearer.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof …
The puppy troop that was trapped outside unexpectedly arrives.

items.speaker: Nelson
items.text: Woof woof!

items.speaker: Wendy
items.text: Woof woof!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof?

items.speaker: Police Dog
items.text: Woof woof woof!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof woof.

items.speaker: Police Dog
items.text: Woof! Woof!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof ... Woof woof…

items.speaker: Alice
items.text: Woof woof!

items.speaker: Wendy
items.text: Woof woof!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof ... woof?!
Footsteps and screaming are getting clearer.

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: Stop it! You cheeky dogs!!

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: Give my microphone back!

items.speaker: Chef
items.text: My bread! I only took a bite!
The scurrying puppies, the owners of these items, and the slow-reacting security guards break the silence that Iverson has worked so hard to maintain.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: What's going on? Who let them in!

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: Sorry, Mr. Iverson. There are too many of them.
Pickles gives a shiver, perhaps because it's getting cold in the exhibition hall or because he has a new impression of his puppy friends.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof woof …

items.speaker: Alice
items.text: Woof!
*sizzling sound*
The old radio next to Pickles makes a slight noise.
Meanwhile, noises also come from the speakers at all corners and the radio broadcasters held by people rushing in.
A new visitor enters the control room breathlessly.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahh! Just in time! Hahaha!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The sharp Pirate Captain has arrived at the grandest stage!
The mixer, the microphone, the radio ... They are the best weapons for this uninvited guest.
The silent radio is soon replaced by a more powerful frequency.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This is 25°E. You are listening to the Rocking APPLe, the most distinctive ship to date!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Salute to my discerning audience, my loving followers!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You guessed it right. This Pirate has hijacked all the radio frequencies here.

items.speaker: Wendy
items.text: Woof woof!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You're able to pick up Radio APPLe clearly from anywhere in London.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whether you're cheering for the moment or wish to change the channel, whether you love rock 'n' roll or hate all music …

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Do not switch!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: If you don't want to miss the moment to unveil a conspiracy …

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: A huge conspiracy about the London authorities and the compelling security robots.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Haahh!!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: My friends, we are in the middle of a huge hoax!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The London authorities have deceived everyone!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It is impossible to have such obedient, flawless, safe, and reliable security robots in this world.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: On the contrary, they use violence, harm citizens, and show no kindness!

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: To cover the backsides and block the news, the man in charge … he keeps out the people who wanna have fun t-t-to visit the Rimet Cup!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Captain Regulus clashed with the robot army at the back entrance of the hall.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The brave captain managed to esca- ... to retreat!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But there's no doubt that this is an infringement of our freedom!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The incompetent London authorities attempted to work with security companies and use their awful robots to govern!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: They want to take our life away, render us helpless, so they can manipulate us!
People are whispering. The scene is like the falling of small rocks before a severe landslide.
The tied-up Diggers is the best proof.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Umm umm! Umm umm umm!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You have my respect, poor ragged lad!
People become confused and surround Iverson, who is noticeably unpleased.

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: What that Pirate said ... Is that true?!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: I am very sure—you are deceived.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: But you did imprison the poor citizen.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: If that's what you think, I can now prove to you ...

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: … the reliability of New Humans' security.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Mr. Madbot, you and your evil plan have been overcome by the justice Captain Regulus!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: London belongs to us, belongs to freedom!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: You're right. In such case, security guards are more flexible.

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: You ... You mean …

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Do something! These people are breaking the rules! Are you just going to stand and watch?

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: Co ... copy that.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: Wh-What are you doing!

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: Ruuuuuun!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Mr. APPLe, here! Put the tape away.
There is a short mutter on the radio.
Then it becomes a declaration of ambition and passion.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Haha. This Pirate's instincts are never wrong.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: My assistant, Mr. APPLe, has first-hand evidence of everything.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It will be the most sensational news. Every news agency will invest millions on it.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The next song, for the exasperated poor authorities ...
The old fuse that was deliberately installed is finally blowing as the temperature rises.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh? Why is the power out?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Uh huh. All is ready.
TO BE CONTINUED ...
